content: Because the batch list was scanned of the bulk orders, the tracking # number was activated and the recipient was notified. However the tracking # and status of the order will NOT be updated throughout the process of it being shipped from one USPS branch to the one closest to you because it wasn’t actually activated, it was merely put into the mail-stream which is the line at which customers and companies are notified that the package has made progress. In your words, the tracking doesn't move.

name: KUVRD_.
content: There is a quick and efficient way to ship out a bulk amount of orders for large companies. It’s called ‘batching’. Any amount of orders higher than 50 is considered a ‘batch’ and the way it works is a USPS employee will receive a batch list with the bulk order. This batch list will indicate the quantity of orders within bulk order and provide the ‘tracking #’ for each order.
